chapter.heading: A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Jehovah saith
unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

Jehovah will
send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

Thy people
offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.

Jehovah hath
sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.

The Lord
at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

He will
judge among the nations, He will fill the places with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.

He will
drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.
